passives: Blood Contract: Naamah gains Debtfire when breaker play marks armor, guard, or ritual structure for staged rupture on contract-scorched court ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a debt, clause, and dominion law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Infernal Dominion.
lore: Naamah is a colossal Infernal Dominion breaker from The Infernal Dominion. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Deity is the older source: Infernal Dominion breaker office: judgement rupture, armor sundering, trial by force; Devils/demon kings: hierarchy, temptation, rulership, court violence.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Deity, not a costume: Naamah shows black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture.. Role silhouette must read as Disruption faith. Materials include black iron, volcanic glass, obsidian, blood wax, ash velvet, molten gold, charred parchment. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid red robot demon, generic Halloween devil, sci-fi cables, literal castle armor, block fortress body, cartoon pitchfork.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Naamah — Black-Iron Clause Cut Rend
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal Dominion source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Contract Debt gain when used from black-iron contract ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Blood-Wax Contract Technique — Rupture
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Builds Contract Debt only when the player uses black-iron contract ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Naamah: Infernal Debt Verdict Sundering Trial
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Contract Debt to impose a two-round rule from Infernal Dominion: breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Hell-Crown Dominion Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Contract Debt, transform nearby terrain into black-iron contract ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Naamah Sunderer Goetic Chain-Crown Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through black-iron contract ground. Visual: black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Naamah Volcanic Glass Debtor Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Infernal Dominion source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Naamah Blood-Wax Infernal Ledger Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Contract Debt and unlocks a mastery branch for Infernal Clause Step, Chain-Lien Reversal, and Collect the Soul Clause. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: break armor, shields, and boss windows
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Naamah's Blood Contract: a solo mechanic where Debtfire grows through contract-scorched court ground, reaction-window mastery, and breaker decisions that mark armor, guard, or ritual structure for staged rupture. Payoff: turn correct sequencing into burst windows against bosses and shields. Counterplay: mistimed burst leaves the Deity exposed during recovery; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
